title: The canonical isomorphism preserves augmentation
statement: Let q_n be the enlarged stage augmentations [def-sc-compact-flat-enlarged-bar-tower], and let e be the full-bar augmentation. For any proof hz that delta;desc(q)=0, the canonical cokernel-to-full-bar isomorphism [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-union-iso] satisfies iso.hom;e=cokernel.desc(delta,desc(q),hz).

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; The canonical isomorphism preserves augmentation.

proof.text: Cancel the epimorphic cokernel projection and use coproduct extensionality. On injection n, the canonical-isomorphism factorization gives the stage-to-full-bar map; its composite with full augmentation is q_n by augmentation naturality. The cokernel desc and coproduct desc equations give the same map on the right. The argument works for every hz.

lemma unionIso_augmentation
    (hz : flatTelescopeDifferential (enlargedBar D E t p hp)
      (enlargedBarMap D E t p hp) ≫
        Sigma.desc (enlargedBarAugmentation D E t p hp) = 0) :
    (unionIso D E t p hp).hom ≫ fullBarAugmentation D E t p hp =
      cokernel.desc (flatTelescopeDifferential (enlargedBar D E t p hp)
        (enlargedBarMap D E t p hp))
          (Sigma.desc (enlargedBarAugmentation D E t p hp)) hz
